What is your go to quick easy meal?
Good although much better with additional of cheese and garlic.

A vegetable curry.

Start by sweating the aromatics in a pot, just like you would for a soup: garlic, onion, carrot, celery, with salt and butter/oil. I throw in spices here as well: cumin, coriander, turmeric, ginger, maybe chili powder.

Once the onions are just starting to turn translucent, add soup stock and coconut milk. I throw in red lentils as well. Add any less hardy vegetables: bamboo shoots, broccoli, peppers. Add curry paste to taste.

Simmer for 15-20 minutes until the lentils are done.

About once a month pork tenderloin goes on sale. I buy about ten pounds and have them butcher it into about quarter inch slabs and wrap them each seperately. I take two pieces, little salt, a little pepper, and some cumin and olive oil. About 10 minutes in a hot skillet, deglaze the pan with some cooking wine and mix it with a little mayo to make a delicious sauce . While the pork rests I do up the dishes quick and throw some peas and carrots in the microwave or spoon out some applesauce. In under twenty minutes I have two restaurant quality pork sandwiches with a side dish and the cleanup is already done. Beats the hell out of Mac n cheese or frozen pizza.
